title: Flood Renewal Share: Replacement Month and Installment Count Bases
content:
For a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the flood renewal share in a review of the flood insurance bills is set on one of two bases where the reserve's file shows them. The flood bills of the review are the flood insurance bills on file for the reserve received no later than the review date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

| Flood bills of the review | Basis | Flood renewal share |
|---|---|---|
| At least one withdrawn | Replacement month basis | The whole calendar months from the due date of the latest paid flood insurance bill to the review date, divided by twelve, never below zero and never above one — a replacement policy renews on the anniversary of its own start |
| None withdrawn; two or more paid or received | Installment count basis | The number of paid flood bills of the review divided by the number of paid and received flood bills of the review |
| Any other file | — | Not set by this rule |

*Hypothetical:* withdrawn bill present, latest paid flood bill due 9 whole months before the review: share three quarters. No withdrawn bill, two flood bills paid or received with one paid: one half.
